title: Shared Knowledge and Pragmatic Complicity: hiszen, ugyebár, mégiscsak

sections.title: Appealing to Shared Premises with 'hiszen'
sections.content: 'Hiszen' (after all / surely) invokes a fact that both speaker and listener already know, using it as justification or gentle protest: 'Nem kell bemutatnom őt, hiszen mindannyian ismeritek' (I don't need to introduce him, after all, you all know him). In dialogue, clause-initial 'Hiszen...' expresses surprise when reality contradicts expectations: 'Hiszen tegnap még egészen mást mondtál!'

sections.title: Seeking Consensus and Ironic Complicity with 'ugyebár'
sections.content: 'Ugyebár' (isn't that so / as is well known) invites agreement or reminds the interlocutor of an inescapable premise: 'A szabályok mindenkire érvényesek, ugyebár?' In ironic contexts, it creates humorous distance by appealing to a pretense both speakers recognize as absurd. 'Mégiscsak' (after all / nonetheless) reasserts a core value or truth despite counter-arguments: 'Mégiscsak érdemes volt eljönni.'

sections.title: Pragmatic Stance Particles
rows: isn't it so? / as you know (seeking agreement or ironic complicity)
well / as you see (discourse marker of obviousness/resignation)

items.spanish: Miért kételkednénk benne, hiszen mindenki ismeri az igazságot?
items.english: Why would we doubt it, after all, everyone knows the truth?

items.spanish: A becsület, ugyebár, mindennél fontosabb egy nemesember számára.
items.english: Honor, as is well known, is more important than anything for a nobleman.

items.spanish: Bár sokba került, mégiscsak megérte felújítani a régi várat.
items.english: Although it cost a lot, it was nonetheless worth renovating the old castle.

items.spanish: Hát persze hogy nem haragszom, csak meglepődtem a híren.
items.english: Well of course I'm not angry, I was just surprised by the news.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: When 'ugyebár' appears mid-sentence as a parenthetical remark, set it off with commas: 'Ez a kérdés, ugyebár, nem tartozik ide.'
